# POST : updateConversation Samples

**API:** Message API
**Type:** REST POST
**Endpoint:** `https://api.ebay.com/commerce/message/v1/update_conversation`
**Method:** POST
**Operation Name:** `updateConversation`

---

## Description

This sample modifies the status of a conversation.

---

**Note:** This operation has 2 sample variations.

---

## Sample 1

### Response Sample

```json
{
    "conversationStatus": "ACTIVE",
    "conversationId": "5********7",
    "conversationType": "FROM_MEMBERS"
}
```

---


## Sample 2

### Response Sample

```json
{
    "conversationId": "5********7",
    "conversationType": "FROM_MEMBERS",
    "read": true
}
```

---
